dedupe_keys.name: multi scale image dataset for semantic segmentation of geotechnical anomalies in mining infrastructure

description: This dataset supports automated visual inspection of mining geotechnical structures. The Zenodo record says it combines orthophoto tiles from three aerial photogrammetric surveys of an active mine, covering waste-rock stockpiles, a tailings dam and an open pit, with 1,529 proximal images from smartphone and drone inspections, manually annotated in COCO JSON for four surface anomalies: water ponding, erosion, cracks and surface ruptures. It was published in July 2026 by Wanderlei Malaquias Pereira Junior of the Universidade Federal de Goiás under the CC BY 4.0 licence with no fee stated, but the record is restricted, so files must be requested from the author. Coverage is one operating mine whose location is not stated on the page read. Caveats: classes are imbalanced, conditions vary, the record lists non-commercial academic use as the intent, and no files were visible on 2026-09-26. For simulation it trains inspection models that feed tailings dam and slope condition monitoring and digital twins of mine infrastructure. Related catalogue records include the global database of tailings flows and the InSAR deformation data for surface mining complexes.
